units.zh: 開運三年冬十月甲子，正衙命使冊皇太妃安氏。
units.en: In winter of Kaiyun 3, on the jiazi day of the tenth month, imperial envoys in full court regalia were sent to invest Grand Imperial Consort Lady An.
units.literal: In Kaiyun 3, winter, tenth month, jiazi: court envoys in imperial accoutrements were commissioned to invest Grand Imperial Consort Lady An.

units.zh: 己丑，以樞密直學士、禮部侍郎邊光範為翰林學士，以給事中邊歸讜為左散騎常侍，以翰林學士、祠部員外郎、知制誥張沆為右諫議大夫。
units.en: On jichou Bian Guangfan, direct academician at the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Minister of Rites, became Hanlin academician; Bian Guiqian, Secretariat drafter, became Left Regular Attendant-in-Attendance; and Zhang Hong, Hanlin academician, outer-section vice director of the Bureau of Rites with charge of edicts, became Right Remonstrance Officer.
units.literal: On jichou Bian Guangfan, direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Minister of Rites, was made Hanlin academician; Bian Guiqian, Secretariat drafter, was made Left Regular Attendant-in-Attendance; Zhang Hong, Hanlin academician, outer-section vice director of the Bureau of Rites with charge of edicts, was made Right Remonstrance Officer.

units.zh: 辛未，以鄴都留守杜威為北面行營都招討使，以侍衛親軍都指揮使、鄆州節度使李守貞為兵馬都監，兗州安審琦為左右廂都指揮使，徐州符彥卿為馬軍左廂都指揮使，滑州皇甫遇為馬軍右廂都指揮使，貝州梁漢璋為馬軍都排陣使，前鄧州宋彥筠為步軍左廂都指揮使，奉國左廂都指揮使王饒為步軍右廂都指揮使，洺州團練使薛懷讓為先鋒都指揮使。
units.en: On xinwei Du Wei, military governor of Yedu, was appointed overall commander of the northern field army; Li Shouzhen, commander of the Imperial Guard and military governor of Yunzhou, became overall supervisor of troops and horses; An Shenqi of Yanzhou commanded both wings; Fu Yanqing of Xuzhou the left wing of cavalry; Huangfu Yu of Huazhou the right wing of cavalry; Liang Hanzhang of Beizhou marshal of the cavalry array; Song Yanyun, former prefect of Dengzhou, the left wing of infantry; Wang Rao of the Fengguo left wing the right wing of infantry; and Xue Huairang, regimental trainer of Mozhou, vanguard commander.
units.literal: On xinwei Du Wei, military governor of Yedu, was made overall commander of the Northern Circuit field headquarters; Li Shouzhen, commander of the Imperial Guard and military governor of Yanzhou, was made overall supervisor of troops and horses; An Shenqi of Yanzhou was made commander of both wings; Fu Yanqing of Xuzhou was made commander of the left wing of the horse army; Huangfu Yu of Huazhou was made commander of the right wing of the horse army; Liang Hanzhang of Beizhou was made marshal of the horse army array; Song Yanyun, former prefect of Dengzhou, was made commander of the left wing of the foot army; Wang Rao, commander of the left wing of the Fengguo army, was made commander of the right wing of the foot army; Xue Huairang, regimental trainer of Mozhou, was made vanguard commander.

units.zh: 〈（案：《通鑒》載，當時敕榜曰：「先取瀛、鄚，安定關南；
units.en: (The Comprehensive Mirror records that the edict placard then read: "First take Ying and Mo and secure the region south of the passes;
units.literal: (Note: The Comprehensive Mirror records that the edict placard at the time read: "First take Ying and Mo and secure the south of the passes;

units.zh: 次復幽、燕，蕩平塞北。」
units.en: then recover You and Yan and sweep the northern frontier clear."
units.literal: next recover You and Yan and sweep the northern frontier."

units.zh: 蓋狃於陽城之役而驟驕也。）〉
units.en: They had grown overconfident after clinging to the victory at Yangcheng.)〉
units.literal: This was because they clung to the victory at Yangcheng and suddenly grew arrogant.)〉

units.zh: 癸酉，冊吳國夫人馮氏為皇后。
units.en: On guiyou Lady Feng of Wu was invested as empress.
units.literal: On guiyou Lady Feng of Wu state was invested as empress.

units.zh: 乙亥，以侍衛馬軍都指揮使李彥韜權知侍衛司事。
units.en: On yihai Li Yantao, commander of the Imperial Guard cavalry, was placed in acting charge of the Imperial Guard bureau.
units.literal: On yihai Li Yantao, commander of the Imperial Guard horse army, was made acting head of the Imperial Guard bureau.

units.zh: 丙戌，鳳翔節度使秦王李從嚴薨，輟朝，冊贈尚書令。
units.en: On bingxu Li Congyan, Prince of Qin and military governor of Fengxiang, died; court was suspended; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Director of the Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: On bingxu Li Congyan, Prince of Qin and military governor of Fengxiang, died; court audiences were suspended; posthumously he was enfeoffed as Director of the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 丁亥，邠州節度使李德充卒，輟朝，贈太尉。
units.en: On dinghai Li Dechong, military governor of Binzhou, died; court was suspended; he was posthumously made Grand Marshal.
units.literal: On dinghai Li Dechong, military governor of Binzhou, died; court audiences were suspended; he was posthumously made Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 十一月戊子朔，以給事中盧撰為右散騎常侍，以尚書兵部郎中兼侍御史、知雜事陳觀為左諫議大夫。
units.en: On the wuzi new moon of the eleventh month Lu Zhuan, Secretariat drafter, became Right Regular Attendant-in-Attendance, and Chen Guan, bureau director in the Ministry of War with concurrent investigating censor and charge of miscellaneous matters, became Left Remonstrance Officer.
units.literal: Eleventh month, wuzi new moon: Lu Zhuan, Secretariat drafter, was made Right Regular Attendant-in-Attendance; Chen Guan, bureau director in the Ministry of War of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent investigating censor with charge of miscellaneous matters, was made Left Remonstrance Officer.

units.zh: 觀以祖諱「義」，乞改官，尋授給事中。
units.en: Because his grandfather's taboo name was "Yi," Chen Guan asked to be reassigned and was soon made Secretariat drafter.
units.literal: Guan, because his grandfather's taboo was "Yi," requested a change of office; shortly he was appointed Secretariat drafter.

units.zh: 庚寅，樞密使、中書侍郎兼戶部尚書、平章事馮玉加尚書右僕射，以皇子鎮寧軍節度使延煦為陜州節度使，以陜州留後焦繼勛為鳳翔留後，以前定州留後安審琦為邠州留後，以右僕射和凝為左僕射。
units.en: On gengyin Feng Yu, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Revenue, and Grand Counsellor, was promoted to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Prince Yanxu, military governor of Zhenning, became military governor of Shanzhou; Jiao Jixun, acting prefect of Shanzhou, acting prefect of Fengxiang; An Shenqi, former acting prefect of Dingzhou, acting prefect of Binzhou; and He Ning moved from Right to Left Vice Director.
units.literal: On gengyin Feng Yu, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Revenue and Grand Counsellor, was advanced to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; the prince Yanxu, military governor of Zhenning army, was made military governor of Shanzhou; Jiao Jixun, acting prefect of Shanzhou, was made acting prefect of Fengxiang; An Shenqi, former acting prefect of Dingzhou, was made acting prefect of Binzhou; He Ning, Right Vice Director, was made Left Vice Director.

units.zh: 甲午，兩浙節度使吳越國王錢宏佐起復舊任。
units.en: On jiawu Qian Hongzuo, King of Wuyue and military governor of the Two Zhes, returned to duty after mourning.
units.literal: On jiawu Qian Hongzuo, King of Wuyue and military governor of the Two Zhes, resumed his former post after mourning.

units.zh: 丁酉，詔李守貞知幽州行府事。
units.en: On dingyou Li Shouzhen was ordered to administer the mobile headquarters at Youzhou.
units.literal: On dingyou an edict made Li Shouzhen administrator of the mobile office at Youzhou.

units.zh: 戊申，日南至，禦崇元殿受朝賀。
units.en: On wushen, the winter solstice, the emperor received New Year court congratulations at the Chongyuan Hall.
units.literal: On wushen, winter solstice, the Emperor took the Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations.

units.zh: 是月，北面行營招討使杜威率諸將領大軍自鄴北征，師次瀛州城下，貝州節度使梁漢璋戰死。
units.en: That month Du Wei, northern field commander, marched a great army north from Ye with his generals; the force halted below Yingzhou, where Liang Hanzhang, military governor of Beizhou, was killed in battle.
units.literal: That month Du Wei, commander of the northern field headquarters, led the generals and a great army north from Ye on campaign; the army halted below Yingzhou city; Liang Hanzhang, military governor of Beizhou, died in battle.

units.zh: 杜威等以漢璋之敗，遂收軍而退。
units.en: After Hanzhang's defeat Du Wei and his commanders withdrew the army.
units.literal: Du Wei and the others, because of Hanzhang's defeat, then drew off the army and retreated.

units.zh: 行次武強，聞契丹入寇，欲取直路，自冀、貝而南。
units.en: When the army reached Wuqiang and heard the Khitans had invaded, they planned to take the direct route south through Ji and Bei.
units.literal: Marching to Wuqiang, they heard the Khitans had invaded; they wished to take the direct route south through Ji and Bei.

units.zh: 會張彥澤領騎自鎮定至，且言契丹可破之狀，於是大軍西趨鎮州。
units.en: Zhang Yanzhe then arrived from Zhen and Ding with cavalry, reporting that the Khitans could be beaten, and the main army turned west toward Zhenzhou.
units.literal: It happened that Zhang Yanzhe led cavalry from Zhen and Ding to arrive, and reported that the Khitans could be defeated; thereupon the great army turned west toward Zhenzhou.

units.zh: 十二月丁巳朔，
units.en: On the dingsi new moon of the twelfth month,
units.literal: Twelfth month, dingsi new moon,

units.zh: 〈（案：以下有闕文。
units.en: (There is missing text below.
units.literal: (Note: There is missing text below.

units.zh: 據《通鑒》云：丁巳朔，李穀自書密奏，且言大軍危急之勢，請車駕幸滑州，遣高行周、符彥卿扈從，及發兵守澶州、河陽，以備敵之奔沖。
units.en: The Comprehensive Mirror records that on the dingsi new moon Li Gu wrote a secret memorial in his own hand describing the army's dire peril, asking that the emperor go to Huazhou with Gao Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing as escort, and that troops be sent to hold Chanzhou and Heyang against a sudden enemy thrust.
units.literal: According to the Comprehensive Mirror: on dingsi new moon Li Gu wrote a secret memorial himself, stating also the army's grave peril, requesting the imperial carriage proceed to Huazhou, dispatching Gao Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing to escort, and sending troops to hold Chenzhou and Heyang to guard against the enemy's sudden thrust.

units.zh: 遣軍將關勛走馬上之。）〉
units.en: He sent the officer Guan Xun to ride posthaste with it.)〉
units.literal: He sent the army officer Guan Xun to gallop and deliver it.)〉

units.zh: 己未，杜威奏，駐軍於中渡橋。
units.en: On jiwei Du Wei reported that the army was encamped at Zhongdu Bridge.
units.literal: On jiwei Du Wei memorialized that the army was encamped at Zhongdu Bridge.

units.zh: 庚申，以前司農卿儲延英為太子賓客。
units.en: On gengshen former Minister of Agriculture Chu Yanying became Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: On gengshen former Minister of Revenue Chu Yanying was made Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 詔徐州符彥卿屯澶州。
units.en: Fu Yanqing of Xuzhou was ordered to garrison Chenzhou.
units.literal: An edict ordered Fu Yanqing of Xuzhou to garrison Chenzhou.

units.zh: 辛酉，詔澤潞、鄴都、邢洺、河陽運糧赴中渡，杜威遣人口奏軍前事宜，勢迫故也。
units.en: On xinyou Ze-Lu, Yedu, Xing-Mo, and Heyang were ordered to ship grain to Zhongdu; Du Wei sent couriers to report orally from the front because the crisis was acute.
units.literal: On xinyou an edict ordered Ze-Lu, Yedu, Xing-Mo, and Heyang to transport grain to Zhongdu; Du Wei sent men to report orally on affairs at the front, because the situation was pressing.

units.zh: 壬戌，又遣高行周屯澶州，景延廣守河陽。
units.en: On renxu Gao Xingzhou was again sent to garrison Chenzhou and Jing Yanguang to defend Heyang.
units.literal: On renxu Gao Xingzhou was again sent to garrison Chenzhou, and Jing Yanguang to hold Heyang.

units.zh: 博野縣都監張鵬入奏蕃軍事勢。
units.en: Zhang Peng, chief inspector of Boye county, reported to court on the Khitan army's disposition.
units.literal: Zhang Peng, chief inspector of Boye county, entered court to report on the barbarian army's situation.

units.zh: 丙寅，定州李殷奏，前月二十八日夜，領捉生四百人往曲陽嘉山下，逢敵軍車帳，殺千餘人，獲馬二百匹。
units.en: On bingyin Li Yin of Dingzhou reported that on the night of the twenty-eighth of the previous month he led four hundred scouts to Jia Mountain below Quyang, struck enemy camps, killed more than a thousand men, and took two hundred horses.
units.literal: On bingyin Li Yin of Dingzhou memorialized: on the night of the twenty-eighth of the previous month he led four hundred scouts to below Jia Mountain at Quyang, encountered enemy carts and tents, killed more than a thousand men, and captured two hundred horses.

units.zh: 詔宋州高行周充北面行營都部署，符彥卿充副，邢州方太充都虞候，領後軍駐於河上，以備敵騎之奔沖也。
units.en: Gao Xingzhou of Songzhou was made overall commander of the northern field army, Fu Yanqing his deputy, and Fang Tai of Xingzhou chief adjutant; they were to hold the rear army on the river against a Khitan cavalry rush.
units.literal: An edict made Gao Xingzhou of Songzhou overall commander of the northern field headquarters, Fu Yanqing his deputy, and Fang Tai of Xingzhou chief adjutant; they were to lead the rear army to encamp on the river to guard against enemy cavalry thrusts.

units.zh: 時契丹遊騎涉滹水而南，至欒城縣。
units.en: Khitan raiders had crossed the Hutuo south as far as Luancheng county.
units.literal: At that time Khitan raiding cavalry crossed the Hutuo River southward as far as Luancheng county.

units.zh: 自是中渡寨為蕃軍隔絕，探報不通，朝廷大恐，故委行周等繼領兵師守扼津要，且以張其勢也。
units.en: The Zhongdu camp was now cut off from the Khitans and no intelligence got through; the court was terrified, so Gao Xingzhou and the others were sent to hold the river crossings and show greater strength.
units.literal: From this the Zhongdu camp was cut off by the barbarian army; scouts and reports could not get through; the court was greatly afraid; therefore Xingzhou and the others were entrusted to take over troops and hold the strategic crossings, and also to display greater force.

units.zh: 己巳，邢州方太奏，此月六日，契丹與王師戰於中渡，王師不利，奉國都指揮使王清戰死。
units.en: On jisi Fang Tai of Xingzhou reported that on the sixth of this month the Khitans fought the imperial army at Zhongdu; the imperial forces were beaten and Wang Qing, commander of the Fengguo army, was killed.
units.literal: On jisi Fang Tai of Xingzhou memorialized: on the sixth of this month the Khitans fought the imperial army at Zhongdu; the imperial army was unfavorable; Wang Qing, commander of the Fengguo army, died in battle.

units.zh: 庚午，幸沙臺射兔。
units.en: On gengwu the emperor went to Shatai to hunt rabbits.
units.literal: On gengwu the Emperor visited Shatai to shoot rabbits.

units.zh: 壬申，始聞杜威、李守貞等以此月十日率諸軍降於契丹。
units.en: On renshen came the first report that on the tenth Du Wei, Li Shouzhen, and the rest had surrendered the armies to the Khitans.
units.literal: On renshen word was first received that on the tenth of this month Du Wei, Li Shouzhen, and the others had led the armies in surrender to the Khitans.

units.zh: 是夜，相州節度使張彥澤受契丹命，率先鋒二千人，自封丘門斬關而入。
units.en: That night Zhang Yanzhe, military governor of Xiangzhou, acting on Khitan orders led two thousand vanguard troops through Fengqiu Gate after cutting down the barrier.
units.literal: That night Zhang Yanzhe, military governor of Xiangzhou, on Khitan orders led two thousand vanguard troops, broke through the gate at Fengqiu Gate, and entered.

units.zh: 癸酉旦，張彥澤頓兵於明德門外，京城大擾。
units.en: At dawn on guiyou Zhang Yanzhe encamped outside the Gate of Illustrious Virtue and the capital fell into uproar.
units.literal: At dawn on guiyou Zhang Yanzhe halted his troops outside the Gate of Illustrious Virtue; the capital was greatly disturbed.

units.zh: 前曹州節度使石赟死，帝之堂叔也。
units.en: Former military governor of Caozhou Shi Yun died; he was the emperor's paternal uncle.
units.literal: Former military governor of Caozhou Shi Yun died; he was the Emperor's paternal uncle.

units.zh: 時自中渡寨隔絕之後，帝與大臣端坐憂危，國之衛兵，悉在北面，計無所出。
units.en: Since the Zhongdu camp had been cut off the emperor and his ministers sat helpless in dread; the imperial guards were all in the north and no plan availed.
units.literal: At that time, from after the Zhongdu camp was cut off, the Emperor and the great ministers sat upright in worry and peril; the state's guard troops were all in the north; no plan could be found.

units.zh: 十六日聞滹水之降。
units.en: On the sixteenth came word of the surrender at the Hutuo.
units.literal: On the sixteenth they heard of the surrender at the Hutuo.

units.zh: 是夜，偵知張彥澤已至滑州，召李崧、馮玉、李彥韜入內計事，方議詔河東劉知遠起兵赴難，至五鼓初，張彥澤引蕃騎入京。
units.en: That night scouts reported Zhang Yanzhe at Huazhou; Li Song, Feng Yu, and Li Yantao were called in to deliberate and were debating an edict for Liu Zhiyuan of Hedong to march to the rescue when at the fifth watch Zhang Yanzhe led Khitan cavalry into the capital.
units.literal: That night scouts learned Zhang Yanzhe had reached Huazhou; Li Song, Feng Yu, and Li Yantao were summoned within to plan; they were just discussing an edict for Liu Zhiyuan of Hedong to raise troops to the rescue when at the first watch of the fifth drum Zhang Yanzhe led barbarian cavalry into the capital.

units.zh: 宮中相次火起，帝自攜劍驅擁后妃已下十數人，將同赴火，為親校薛超所持。
units.en: Fires broke out across the palace; the emperor drew his sword and drove the empress, consorts, and a dozen attendants toward the flames to die with them, but his personal guard Xue Chao seized him.
units.literal: Fires broke out one after another in the palace; the Emperor himself took a sword and drove the empress, consorts, and more than ten others below them, intending to enter the fire together; he was seized by his personal officer Xue Chao.

units.zh: 俄自寬仁門遞入契丹主與皇太后書，帝乃止，旋令撲滅煙火。
units.en: Soon a letter from the Khitan lord and the empress dowager was brought in at Kuanren Gate; the emperor desisted and ordered the fires put out.
units.literal: Shortly a letter from the Khitan lord and the Empress Dowager was delivered in at Kuanren Gate; the Emperor then stopped, and immediately ordered the smoke and fire extinguished.

units.zh: 大內都點檢康福全在寬仁門宿衛，登樓覘賊，彥澤呼而下之。
units.en: Kang Fuquan, chief inspector of the inner palace, was on guard at Kuanren Gate; he climbed the tower to watch the enemy until Yanzhe called him down.
units.literal: Kang Fuquan, chief inspector of the inner palace, was on night guard at Kuanren Gate; he mounted the tower to spy on the bandits; Yanzhe called him down.

units.zh: 癸酉，帝奉表於戎主曰：
units.en: On guiyou the emperor submitted a memorial to the Khitan lord, saying:
units.literal: On guiyou the Emperor submitted a memorial to the barbarian lord, saying:

units.zh: 孫臣某言：今月十七日寅時，相州節度使張彥澤、都監傅住兒部領大軍入京，賫到翁皇帝賜太后書示，於滹沱河降下杜重威一行馬步兵士，見領蕃漢步騎來幸汴州者。
units.en: Your grandson-subject reports: at the yin hour on the seventeenth Zhang Yanzhe, military governor of Xiangzhou, and chief inspector Fu Zhu'er entered the capital with a great army, bringing the letter the Imperial Father sent the empress dowager; Du Chongwei's horse and foot had surrendered at the Hutuo, and Khitan and Han forces were now marching on Bianzhou.
units.literal: Your grandson-subject speaks: on the seventeenth of this month at the yin hour, Zhang Yanzhe, military governor of Xiangzhou, and the chief inspector Fu Zhu'er led a great army into the capital, bearing and displaying the letter the Imperial Father granted the Empress Dowager; at the Hutuo Du Chongwei's party of horse and foot soldiers had surrendered; they are now leading Khitan and Han foot and horse coming to favor Bianzhou.

units.zh: 往者，唐運告終，中原失馭，數窮否極，天缺地傾。
units.en: Formerly Tang's mandate had ended, the Central Plains had lost their helm, fate had reached its nadir, and heaven and earth seemed to collapse.
units.literal: Formerly Tang's mandate ended, the Central Plains lost control, numbers exhausted and obstruction extreme, heaven gapped and earth tilted.

units.zh: 先人有田一成，有眾一旅，兵連禍結，力屈勢孤。
units.en: My forebear held but a patch of land and a single brigade; war piled on disaster until his strength failed and he stood alone.
units.literal: Our forebear had fields one patch, followers one brigade; arms linked with calamity knotted; strength bent, position solitary.

units.zh: 翁皇帝救患摧鋒，興利除害，躬擐甲胄，深入寇場。
units.en: The Imperial Father relieved our distress, broke the enemy spear line, brought benefit and removed harm, donned armor himself, and plunged deep into the enemy country.
units.literal: The Imperial Father rescued distress and crushed spearpoints, raised benefit and removed harm, personally donned armor, and went deep into the bandit field.

units.zh: 犯露蒙霜，度雁門之險；
units.en: Braving dew and frost he crossed the peril of Yanmen Pass;
units.literal: Braving dew and shrouded in frost, he crossed the peril of Yanmen;

units.zh: 馳風掣電，行中冀之誅。
units.en: riding like wind and lightning he carried out judgment in central Ji.
units.literal: wind-chasing, lightning-snatching, he executed punishment in central Ji.

units.zh: 黃鉞一麾，天下大定。
units.en: One wave of the imperial axe and the realm was settled.
units.literal: With one wave of the yellow battle-axe, all under Heaven was greatly settled.

units.zh: 勢淩宇宙，義感神明，功成不居，遂興晉祚，則翁皇帝有大造於石氏也。
units.en: His power spanned the cosmos and his righteousness moved the gods; when his task was done he did not keep the glory but raised the Jin throne—thus the Imperial Father wrought the greatest service for the house of Shi.
units.literal: His power overrode cosmos; his righteousness moved spirits; achievement complete he did not dwell on it; he then raised the Jin mandate—thus the Imperial Father had great creating merit toward the Shi clan.

units.zh: 旋屬天降鞠兇，先君即世，臣遵承遺旨，纘紹前基。
units.en: Soon Heaven sent cruel misfortune and my father died; I followed his last charge and continued his foundation.
units.literal: Soon it fell to Heaven sending harsh misfortune; the former lord departed the world; your subject followed the testamentary charge and continued the former foundation.

units.zh: 諒暗之初，荒迷失次，凡有軍國重事，皆委將相大臣。
units.en: In the first days of mourning I was lost and disordered; all grave matters of state I left to my generals and ministers.
units.literal: At the start of deep mourning I was lost and out of order; all weighty affairs of army and state were entrusted to generals and ministers.

units.zh: 至於擅繼宗祧，既非稟命；
units.en: As for seizing the succession without your command,
units.literal: As for usurping succession to the ancestral temple, it was not by received command;

units.zh: 輕發文字，輒敢抗尊。
units.en: they issued documents lightly and dared defy your authority.
units.literal: lightly issuing documents, they dared resist your exalted person.

units.zh: 自啟釁端，果貽赫怒，禍至神惑，運盡天亡。
units.en: They provoked conflict and brought your wrath; disaster came, the spirits were confounded, and our mandate was spent.
units.literal: They themselves opened the provocation; truly they brought your blazing wrath; calamity arrived, spirits were confused, fortune exhausted, Heaven's mandate perished.

units.zh: 十萬師徒，皆望風而束手；
units.en: A hundred thousand soldiers all laid down their arms at the first wind;
units.literal: A hundred thousand troops all looked to the wind and bound their hands;

units.zh: 億兆黎庶，悉延頸以歸心。
units.en: and the people everywhere craned their necks in submission.
units.literal: hundreds of millions of common people all stretched their necks to turn their hearts.

units.zh: 臣負義包羞，貪生忍恥，自貽顛覆，上累祖宗，偷度晨昏，茍存食息。
units.en: I bear shame and disgrace, clinging to life; I brought ruin on myself and burdened my ancestors, stealing through each day merely to breathe.
units.literal: Your subject bears righteousness wrapped in shame, clings to life and endures disgrace, himself brings downfall, above burdens the ancestors, steals through dawn and dusk, barely preserves breath and food.

units.zh: 翁皇帝若惠顧疇昔，稍霽雷霆，未賜靈誅，不絕先祀，則百口荷更生之德，一門銜無報之恩，雖所願焉，非敢望也。
units.en: If the Imperial Father would look kindly on past ties, temper his wrath, spare us execution, and let our ancestral rites continue, a hundred mouths would owe you reborn life and our whole clan a debt we could never repay—this is our hope, though we dare not expect it.
units.literal: If the Imperial Father in kindness looks to former days, slightly clears his thunder, does not grant spirit punishment, does not cut off ancestral sacrifices, then a hundred mouths would bear the virtue of renewed life, one clan would hold gratitude beyond repayment—though this is what we wish, we dare not expect it.

units.zh: 臣與太后並妻馮氏及舉家戚屬，見於郊野面縛俟罪次。
units.en: The empress dowager, my wife Lady Feng, our kin, and I wait bound in the suburbs to receive judgment.
units.literal: Your subject with the Empress Dowager, wife Lady Feng, and all household kin are now in the suburbs, faces bound, awaiting judgment.

units.zh: 所有國寶一面、金印三面，今遣長子陜府節度使延煦、次子曹州節度使延寶管押進納，並奉表請罪，陳謝以聞。
units.en: I send the state seal and three gold seals under escort of my eldest son Yanxu, military governor of Shan, and my second son Yanbao, military governor of Caozhou, with this memorial begging your pardon.
units.literal: The state treasure one face and gold seals three faces—now your eldest son Yanxu, military governor of Shan prefecture circuit, and second son Yanbao, military governor of Caozhou, are sent to escort and present them, together submitting this memorial begging pardon, declaring apology for your hearing.

units.zh: 甲戌，張彥澤遷帝與太后及諸宮屬於開封府，遣控鶴指揮使李榮將兵監守。
units.en: On jiaxu Zhang Yanzhe moved the emperor, empress dowager, and palace household to the Kaifeng prefectural offices and set Li Rong, commander of the Crane-Control Guard, to watch them with troops.
units.literal: On jiaxu Zhang Yanzhe moved the Emperor, Empress Dowager, and all palace personnel to the Kaifeng prefecture office; he sent Li Rong, commander of the Crane-Control army, to lead troops and guard them.

units.zh: 是夜，開封尹桑維翰、宣徽使孟承誨皆遇害。
units.en: That night Sang Weihan, prefect of Kaifeng, and Meng Chenghui, commissioner of the Palace Secretariat, were murdered.
units.literal: That night Sang Weihan, prefect of Kaifeng, and Meng Chenghui, commissioner of the Palace Secretariat, were both killed.

units.zh: 帝以契丹主將至，欲與太后出迎，彥澤先表之，稟契丹主之旨報云：「比欲許爾朝覲上國，臣僚奏言，豈有兩個天子道路相見！
units.en: When the Khitan lord was expected the emperor wished to go out with the empress dowager to welcome him; Yanzhe reported the Khitan reply: "We meant to let you come to court in the superior state, but your ministers said, How can two Sons of Heaven meet on the road!
units.literal: The Emperor, because the Khitan lord was about to arrive, wished to go out with the Empress Dowager to welcome him; Yanzhe first memorialized, reporting the Khitan lord's order: "We lately wished to permit you to pay court in the superior state; your ministers memorialized, saying, How can two Sons of Heaven meet on the road!

units.zh: 今賜所佩刀子，以慰爾心。」
units.en: We now give you the knife at our belt to comfort you."
units.literal: Now we bestow the knife at our belt to comfort your heart."

units.zh: 己卯，皇子延煦、延寶自帳中回，得敵詔慰撫，帝表謝之。
units.en: On jimao Princes Yanxu and Yanbao returned from the Khitan camp with a comforting edict, and the emperor sent a memorial of thanks.
units.literal: On jimao the princes Yanxu and Yanbao returned from the enemy camp, received the enemy edict of consolation, and the Emperor submitted a memorial of thanks.

units.zh: 時契丹主以所送傳國寶制造非工，與載籍所述者異，使人來問。
units.en: The Khitan lord found the state seal they had sent poorly made and unlike the records, and sent envoys to question it.
units.literal: At that time the Khitan lord, because the transmitted state treasure sent was crudely made and differed from what the records described, sent men to inquire.

units.zh: 帝進狀曰：「頃以偽主王從珂於洛京大內自焚之後，其真傳國寶不知所在，必是當時焚之。
units.en: The emperor replied: "After the usurper Wang Congke burned himself in the Luoyang palace the true imperial seal was lost and must have perished in that fire.
units.literal: The Emperor submitted a statement: "Lately, after the false ruler Wang Congke burned himself in the great inner palace at Luoyang, the true transmitted state treasure's whereabouts were unknown; it must have been burned at that time.

units.zh: 先帝受命，旋制此寶，在位臣僚，備知其事。
units.en: My father received the mandate and had this seal made at once; the ministers then in office all know this.
units.literal: The former Emperor received the mandate and promptly had this treasure made; ministers in office all know the matter fully.

units.zh: 臣至今日，敢有隱藏」云。
units.en: I would not conceal anything today," he said.
units.literal: Your subject to this day would not dare conceal it," he said.

units.zh: 時移內庫至府，帝使人取帛數段，主者不與，謂使者曰：「此非我所有也。」
units.en: When the inner treasury was moved to the prefectural offices the emperor sent for several bolts of silk; the keeper refused, telling the envoy, "These are no longer mine."
units.literal: At that time the inner treasury was moved to the prefecture office; the Emperor sent men to take several bolts of silk; the custodian would not give them, telling the envoy: "These are not mine to own."

units.zh: 又使人詣李崧求酒，崧曰：「臣有酒非敢愛惜，慮陛下杯酌之後憂躁，所作別有不測之事，臣以此不敢奉進。」
units.en: He also sent to Li Song for wine; Song said, "I have wine and would not begrudge it, but I fear that after you drink in grief you might do something desperate; for that I dare not send it."
units.literal: He also sent men to Li Song to request wine; Song said: "Your subject has wine and would not dare be stingy, but fears that after Your Majesty drinks a cup in worry and agitation you might do something else unforeseen; for this your subject dares not present it."

units.zh: 丙戌晦，百官宿封禪寺。
units.en: On the last day of the month, bingxu, the officials lodged at Fengchan Temple.
units.literal: On bingxu, last day of the month, the hundred officials lodged at Fengchan Temple.

units.zh: 明年正月朔，契丹主次東京城北。
units.en: On New Year's Day of the following year the Khitan lord encamped north of the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: On the new moon of the first month of the following year the Khitan lord halted north of the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 百官列班，遙辭帝於寺，詣北郊以迎契丹主。
units.en: The officials formed ranks, bade the emperor farewell at the temple from afar, and went to the northern suburb to welcome the Khitan lord.
units.literal: The hundred officials formed ranks, took leave of the Emperor at the temple from afar, and went to the northern suburb to welcome the Khitan lord.

units.zh: 帝舉族出封丘門，肩轝至野，契丹主不與之見，遣泊封禪寺。
units.en: The emperor and his clan went out Fengqiu Gate in litters to the open field; the Khitan lord refused to see them and had them lodged at Fengchan Temple.
units.literal: The Emperor and his whole clan went out Fengqiu Gate, were carried on litters to the open field; the Khitan lord would not meet them and sent them to moor at Fengchan Temple.

units.zh: 文武百官素服紗帽，迎謁契丹主於郊次，俯伏俟罪，契丹主命起之，親自慰撫。
units.en: Civil and military officials in white dress and gauze caps met the Khitan lord in the suburbs, prostrated themselves to await judgment, and he ordered them up and consoled them in person.
units.literal: Civil and military officials in plain dress and gauze caps welcomed and attended the Khitan lord at the suburban station, prostrated themselves awaiting punishment; the Khitan lord ordered them raised and personally consoled them.

units.zh: 契丹主遂入大內，至昏出宮，是夜宿於赤堈。
units.en: The Khitan lord then entered the inner palace, left at dusk, and that night lodged at Chikan.
units.literal: The Khitan lord then entered the great inner palace; at dusk he left the palace; that night he lodged at Chikan.

units.zh: 偽詔應晉朝臣僚一切仍舊，朝廷儀制並用漢禮。
units.en: A puppet edict declared that Later Jin officials would remain in place and court ritual would follow Han practice.
units.literal: A false edict responded that Jin dynasty officials were all to remain as before; court ritual and institutions were all to use Han rites.

units.zh: 戊子，殺鄭州防禦使楊承勛，責以背父之罪，令左右臠割而死。
units.en: On wuzi Yang Chengxun, defender of Zhengzhou, was executed for betraying his father and dismembered by the guards.
units.literal: On wuzi Yang Chengxun, defender of Zhengzhou, was killed; charged with the crime of betraying his father, he was ordered dismembered by attendants until dead.

units.zh: 〈（《遼史》：以其弟承信為平盧軍節度使，襲父爵。）〉
units.en: (The History of Liao records that his younger brother Chengxin was made military governor of Pinglu and inherited their father's title.)〉
units.literal: (History of Liao: his younger brother Chengxin was made military governor of Pinglu army and inherited his father's title.)〉

units.zh: 己丑，斬張彥澤於市，以其剽劫京城，恣行屠害也。
units.en: On jichou Zhang Yanzhe was beheaded in the market for plundering the capital and slaughtering at will.
units.literal: On jichou Zhang Yanzhe was beheaded in the market, because he had plundered the capital and wantonly carried out slaughter.

units.zh: 〈（《遼史》云：以張彥澤擅徙重貴開封，殺桑維翰，縱兵大掠，不道，斬於市。）〉
units.en: (The History of Liao says Zhang Yanzhe was beheaded in the market for moving Chonggui to Kaifeng on his own authority, killing Sang Weihan, and letting his troops loot the city.)〉
units.literal: (The History of Liao says: because Zhang Yanzhe on his own moved Chonggui to Kaifeng, killed Sang Weihan, and let his troops plunder greatly—unprincipled conduct—he was beheaded in the market.)〉

units.zh: 庚寅，洛京留守景延廣自扼吭而死。
units.en: On gengyin Jing Yanguang, military governor of Luoyang, killed himself by strangling.
units.literal: On gengyin Jing Yanguang, military governor of the Luoyang capital, died by throttling his own throat.

units.zh: 辛卯，契丹制，降帝為光祿大夫、檢校太尉，封負義侯，黃龍府安置。
units.en: On xinmao the Khitans demoted the emperor to Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and Acting Grand Marshal, enfeoffed him as Marquis Who Bears Guilt, and sent him to Huanglong prefecture.
units.literal: On xinmao by Khitan decree the demoted Emperor was made Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Acting Grand Marshal, enfeoffed as Marquis Who Bears Guilt, and settled at Huanglong prefecture.

units.zh: 其地在渤海國界。
units.en: That region lay on the border of the Bohai kingdom.
units.literal: That place was on the border of the Bohai state.

units.zh: 癸巳，遷帝於封禪寺，遣蕃大將崔廷勛將兵守之。
units.en: On guisi the emperor was moved to Fengchan Temple under guard of the Khitan general Cui Tingxun and his troops.
units.literal: On guisi the Emperor was moved to Fengchan Temple; the barbarian great general Cui Tingxun was sent with troops to guard him.

units.zh: 癸卯，帝與皇太后李氏、皇太妃安氏、皇后馮氏、皇弟重睿、皇子延煦延寶俱北行，以宮嬪五十人、內官三十人、東西班五十人、醫官一人、控鶴官四人、禦廚七人、茶酒三人、儀鸞司三人、軍健二十人從行。
units.en: On guimao the emperor went north with Empress Dowager Li, Grand Imperial Consort An, Empress Feng, his brother Chongrui, and Princes Yanxu and Yanbao, attended by fifty palace women, thirty eunuchs, fifty court attendants, a physician, four Crane-Control officers, seven imperial cooks, three tea and wine servants, three from the Ceremonial Parasol bureau, and twenty guards.
units.literal: On guimao the Emperor with Empress Dowager Lady Li, Grand Imperial Consort Lady An, Empress Lady Feng, younger brother Chongrui, and princes Yanxu and Yanbao all went north together, with fifty palace women, thirty inner eunuchs, fifty eastern and western shift attendants, one medical officer, four Crane-Control officers, seven imperial kitchen staff, three tea and wine servants, three Ceremonial Parasol bureau staff, and twenty military guards accompanying.

units.zh: 宰臣趙瑩、樞密使馮玉、侍衛馬軍都指揮使李彥韜隨帝入蕃，契丹主遣三百騎援送而去。
units.en: Grand Counsellor Zhao Ying, Commissioner Feng Yu, and Li Yantao, commander of the Imperial Guard cavalry, accompanied the emperor into Khitan territory while the Khitan lord sent three hundred horsemen as escort.
units.literal: Grand Counsellor Zhao Ying, Commissioner Feng Yu, and Li Yantao, commander of the Imperial Guard horse army, followed the Emperor into the barbarians; the Khitan lord sent three hundred cavalry to escort and send them off.

units.zh: 所經州郡，長吏迎奉，皆為契丹主阻絕，有所供饋亦不通。
units.en: Wherever they passed local officials tried to welcome them, but the Khitan lord blocked every approach and no gifts could reach the party.
units.literal: In every prefecture and commandery passed through, the chief officials came to welcome and attend, but all were blocked by the Khitan lord; any offerings they had could not get through.

units.zh: 〈（《宋史·李穀傳》：少帝蒙塵而北，舊臣無敢候謁者，穀獨拜迎於路，君臣相對泣下。
units.en: (Biography of Li Gu in the History of Song: when the Young Emperor was driven north in disgrace, former ministers dared not greet him; Gu alone bowed to him on the road, and ruler and subject wept together.
units.literal: (Biography of Li Gu in the History of Song: when the Young Emperor suffered dust on the road north, old ministers dared not wait upon and attend him; Gu alone bowed and welcomed him on the road; ruler and subject faced each other and wept.

units.zh: 穀曰：「臣無狀，負陛下。」
units.en: Gu said, "I have disgraced myself and failed Your Majesty."
units.literal: Gu said: "Your subject is without form, having failed Your Majesty."

units.zh: 因傾囊以獻。）〉
units.en: Then he emptied his purse and gave all he had.)〉
units.literal: Thereupon he emptied his purse and presented it.)〉

units.zh: 嘗一日，帝與太后不能得食，乃殺畜而啖之。
units.en: One day the emperor and empress dowager could get no food and killed livestock to eat.
units.literal: Once on a day the Emperor and Empress Dowager could not obtain food; they then killed livestock and ate it.

units.zh: 帝過中渡橋，閱前杜威營寨之跡，慨然憤嘆，謂左右曰：「我家何負，為此賊所破，天乎！
units.en: Crossing Zhongdu Bridge the emperor looked over Du Wei's old camp, sighed in rage, and said to his attendants, "What had my house done to be ruined by this traitor—O Heaven!
units.literal: The Emperor passed Zhongdu Bridge, reviewed the traces of Du Wei's former camp, sighed in indignant lament, and told those beside him: "What fault has my house, that this bandit broke us—Heaven!

units.zh: 天乎！」
units.en: O Heaven!"
units.literal: Heaven!"

units.zh: 於是號慟而去。
units.en: Then he wailed and went on.
units.literal: Thereupon he wailed in grief and departed.

units.zh: 至幽州，傾城士庶迎看於路，見帝慘沮，無不嗟嘆。
units.en: At Youzhou the whole city turned out along the road; seeing the emperor's misery, everyone sighed.
units.literal: Reaching Youzhou, the whole city's gentry and commoners came out on the road to look; seeing the Emperor's wretched dejection, none failed to sigh in lament.

units.zh: 〈（《宣政雜錄》：徽宗北狩，經薊縣梁魚務，有還鄉橋，石少帝所命名也，里人至今呼之。）〉
units.en: (Miscellaneous Records of Xuanzheng's Reign: when Huizong was taken north he passed Liangyu post in Jixian, where a Returning Home Bridge named by the Shi Young Emperor is still known by that name.)〉
units.literal: (Miscellaneous Records of Xuanzheng's Reign: when Huizong went north on the hunt, passing Liangyu post in Jixian, there was a Returning Home Bridge, named by the Young Emperor of Shi; villagers to this day call it so.)〉

units.zh: 駐留旬餘，州將承契丹命，犒帝於府署，趙延壽母以食饌來獻。
units.en: After more than ten days' halt the prefect, on Khitan orders, entertained the emperor at the prefectural offices, and Zhao Yanshou's mother brought food.
units.literal: They halted more than ten days; the prefectural commander, on Khitan orders, entertained the Emperor at the prefecture office; Zhao Yanshou's mother came to present food.

units.zh: 自范陽行數十程，過薊州、平州，至榆關沙塞之地，略無供給，每至宿頓，無非路次，一行乏食，宮女、從官但采木實野蔬，以救饑弊。
units.en: From Fanyang they marched dozens of stages through Jizhou and Pingzhou to the sandy frontier at Yuguan with almost no supplies; each night they camped by the road, and palace women and attendants gathered wild fruit and greens to stave off starvation.
units.literal: From Fanyang they traveled several tens of stages, passed Jizhou and Pingzhou, reached the sandy frontier at Yuguan; supplies were nearly absent; whenever they halted for the night it was always by the roadside; the whole party lacked food; palace women and attendants only gathered tree fruit and wild vegetables to relieve hunger and exhaustion.

units.zh: 又行七八日至錦州，契丹迫帝與妃後往拜安巴堅遺像，帝不勝屈辱，泣曰：「薛超誤我，不令我死，以至今日也。」
units.en: Seven or eight days later at Jinzhou the Khitans forced the emperor and his consorts to bow before Ambaqan's portrait; overcome with shame he wept, "Xue Chao was wrong to keep me from death and bring me to this day."
units.literal: After another seven or eight days they reached Jinzhou; the Khitans forced the Emperor and consorts to go pay respects to Ambaqan's portrait; the Emperor could not bear the humiliation and wept: "Xue Chao wronged me, not letting me die, until today."

units.zh: 又行數十程，渡遼水，至黃龍府，即此所命安置之地也。
units.en: After many more stages they crossed the Liao and reached Huanglong prefecture, the place where he had been ordered to live.
units.literal: After another several tens of stages they crossed the Liao River and reached Huanglong prefecture—this was the place appointed for their settlement.

units.zh: 六月，契丹國母召帝一行往懷密州，州在黃龍府西北千戎王裏。
units.en: In the sixth month the Khitan empress dowager summoned the party to Huaimi prefecture, a thousand li northwest of Huanglong.
units.literal: In the sixth month the Khitan empress dowager summoned the Emperor's party to Huaimi prefecture; the prefecture was a thousand li northwest of Huanglong prefecture.

units.zh: 行至遼陽，皇后馮氏以帝陷蕃，過受艱苦，令內官潛求毒藥，將自飲之，並以進帝，不果而止。
units.en: At Liaoyang Empress Feng, seeing how the emperor suffered in captivity, secretly asked eunuchs for poison to take herself and offer him; the attempt failed and she desisted.
units.literal: Reaching Liaoyang, Empress Lady Feng, because the Emperor had fallen among the barbarians and suffered excessive hardship, had inner eunuchs secretly seek poison, intending to drink it herself and also present it to the Emperor; it did not succeed and she stopped.

units.zh: 又行二百里，會國母為永康王所執，永康王請帝卻往遼陽城駐泊，帝遣使奉表於永康，且賀克捷，自是帝一行稍得供給。
units.en: Two hundred li farther on the Khitan empress dowager was seized by the Prince of Yongkang, who asked the emperor to return to Liaoyang; the emperor sent a memorial congratulating his victory, and thereafter the party received some supplies.
units.literal: After another two hundred li it happened that the empress dowager was seized by the Prince of Yongkang; the Prince of Yongkang asked the Emperor to turn back and moor at Liaoyang city; the Emperor sent envoys submitting a memorial to Yongkang and also congratulating him on victory; from this the Emperor's party slightly obtained supplies.

units.zh: 漢乾祐元年四月，永康王至遼陽，帝與太后並詣帳中，帝御白衣紗帽，永康止之，以常服謁見。
units.en: In the fourth month of Qianyou 1 of Han the Prince of Yongkang reached Liaoyang; the emperor and empress dowager went together to his tent; the emperor came in white robes and a gauze cap, but Yongkang stopped him and received him in ordinary dress.
units.literal: In the fourth month of Han Qianyou 1, the Prince of Yongkang reached Liaoyang; the Emperor and Empress Dowager together went to his tent; the Emperor wore white robes and a gauze cap, but Yongkang stopped him and received him in ordinary dress.

units.zh: 帝伏地雨泣，自陳過咎，永康使左右扶帝上殿，慰勞久之，因命設樂行酒，從容而罷。
units.en: The emperor prostrated himself weeping and confessed his faults; Yongkang had attendants help him into the hall, consoled him at length, ordered music and wine, and dismissed him at ease.
units.literal: The Emperor prostrated himself weeping, confessing his faults; Yongkang had attendants help the Emperor up to the hall, consoled him at length, then ordered music and wine, and dismissed him at ease.

units.zh: 永康帳下從官及教坊內人望見故主，不勝悲咽，內人皆以衣帛藥餌獻遺於帝。
units.en: Yongkang's attendants and palace women of the music bureau saw their former lord and wept; the inner women all presented robes, silks, and medicines to the emperor.
units.literal: Yongkang's attendants and inner women of the music bureau saw their former lord and could not overcome their grief; the inner women all presented robes, silks, and medicines to the Emperor.

units.zh: 及永康發離遼陽，取內官十五人、東西班十五人及皇子延煦，並令隨帳上陘，陘即蕃王避暑之地也。
units.en: When Yongkang left Liaoyang he took fifteen eunuchs, fifteen eastern and western shift attendants, and Prince Yanxu, and had them follow his camp up to the pass—the Khitan king's summer retreat.
units.literal: When Yongkang departed Liaoyang, he took fifteen inner eunuchs, fifteen eastern and western shift attendants, and Prince Yanxu, and had them follow his camp up to the pass—the pass being the Khitan king's summer retreat.

units.zh: 有禪奴舍利者，即永康之妻兄也，知帝有小公主在室，詣帝求之，帝辭以年幼不可。
units.en: One Channu Sheli, Yongkang's wife's elder brother, learning the emperor had a young princess at home asked for her; the emperor refused on grounds of her youth.
units.literal: There was one Channu Sheli, Yongkang's wife's elder brother, who knowing the Emperor had a young princess at home came to request her; the Emperor declined on grounds of her youth.

units.zh: 又有東西班數輩善於歌唱，禪奴又請之，帝乃與之。
units.en: Several eastern and western shift attendants skilled at singing were also requested by Channu, and the emperor gave them up.
units.literal: There were also several from the eastern and western shifts skilled at singing whom Channu again requested, and the Emperor gave them up.

units.zh: 後數日，永康王馳取帝幼女而去，以賜綽諾錫裏。
units.en: Several days later the Prince of Yongkang rode off with the emperor's young daughter and gave her to Chuonuo Xili.
units.literal: Several days later the Prince of Yongkang rode off with the Emperor's young daughter and gave her to Chuonuo Xili.

units.zh: 至八月，永康王下陘，太后馳至霸州，詣永康，求於漢兒城寨側近賜養種之地，永康許諾，令太后於建州住泊。
units.en: In the eighth month, as the Prince of Yongkang descended from the pass, the empress dowager rode in haste to Bazhou to see Yongkang and ask for land to farm near the Han'er stockade; Yongkang agreed and had her lodge at Jianzhou.
units.literal: In the eighth month, as the Prince of Yongkang descended from the pass, the Empress Dowager rode in haste to Bazhou to see Yongkang and ask for land to farm and settle near the Han'er stockade; Yongkang agreed and had the Empress Dowager lodge at Jianzhou.

units.zh: 漢乾祐二年二月，帝自遼陽城發赴建州。
units.en: In the second month of Qianyou 2 of Han the emperor left Liaoyang for Jianzhou.
units.literal: In the second month of Han Qianyou 2 the Emperor set out from Liaoyang city for Jianzhou.

units.zh: 行至中路，太妃安氏得疾而薨，乃焚之，載其燼骨而行。
units.en: On the way Grand Imperial Consort An fell ill and died; they cremated her and carried her ashes onward.
units.literal: Midway on the journey Grand Imperial Consort Lady An fell ill and died; they cremated her and carried her ashes as they went.

units.zh: 帝自遼陽行十數日，過儀州、灞州，遂至建州。
units.en: From Liaoyang the emperor traveled more than ten days through Yizhou and Bazhou to Jianzhou.
units.literal: The Emperor from Liaoyang traveled more than ten days, passed Yizhou and Bazhou, and then reached Jianzhou.

units.zh: 節度使趙延暉盡禮奉迎，館帝於衙署中。
units.en: Military governor Zhao Yanhui received him with full ceremony and lodged the emperor in the prefectural offices.
units.literal: Military governor Zhao Yanhui welcomed him with full ritual courtesy and lodged the Emperor in the prefectural offices.

units.zh: 其後割寨地五千餘頃，其地至建州數十里。
units.en: Later they granted more than five thousand qing of settlement land a few tens of li from Jianzhou.
units.literal: Afterward they allotted more than five thousand qing of fortified settlement land; the land was several tens of li from Jianzhou.

units.zh: 帝乃令一行人員於寨地內築室分耕，給食於帝。
units.en: The emperor had his party build houses on the land, divide fields for farming, and supply his food.
units.literal: The Emperor then ordered the party within the settlement land to build houses, divide fields, and cultivate, providing food for the Emperor.

units.zh: 是歲，述律王子遣契丹數騎詣帝，取內人趙氏、聶氏疾馳而去。
units.en: That year the prince of Shulü sent Khitan horsemen who seized the palace women Lady Zhao and Lady Nie and rode off with them.
units.literal: That year the prince of Shulü sent several Khitan horsemen to the Emperor, took the inner women Lady Zhao and Lady Nie, and galloped away swiftly.

units.zh: 趙、聶者，帝之寵姬也，及其被奪，不勝悲憤。
units.en: Zhao and Nie were his favorite concubines; when they were taken he was overcome with grief and anger.
units.literal: Zhao and Nie were the Emperor's favored concubines; when they were seized he could not overcome grief and rage.

units.zh: 漢乾祐三年八月，太后薨。
units.en: In the eighth month of Qianyou 3 of Han the empress dowager died.
units.literal: In the eighth month of Han Qianyou 3 the Empress Dowager died.

units.zh: 周顯德初，有漢人自塞北而至者，言帝與後及諸子俱無恙，猶在建州，其隨從職官役使人輩，自蕃中亡歸，物故者大半矣。
units.en: Early in Xiande of Zhou, Han travelers from the northern frontier reported that the emperor, empress, and sons were still alive at Jianzhou; of the officials and servants who escaped from captivity, more than half had perished.
units.literal: At the start of Zhou Xiande, Han people came from north of the passes saying the Emperor, empress, and all sons were unharmed and still at Jianzhou; of the accompanying officials, clerks, and servants who fled back from among the barbarians, more than half had died.

units.zh: 〈（《郡齋讀書志》云：《晉朝陷蕃記》，範質撰。
units.en: (Gazetteer of Books Read in the Prefect's Study: Record of the Jin Dynasty's Fall among the Barbarians, by Fan Zhi.
units.literal: (Gazetteer of Books Read in the Prefect's Study says: Record of the Jin Dynasty's Fall among the Barbarians, composed by Fan Zhi.

units.zh: 質，石晉末在翰林，為出帝草降表，知其事為詳。
units.en: Zhi served in the Hanlin at the end of Later Jin and drafted the Outgoing Emperor's surrender memorial, so he knew these events in detail.
units.literal: Zhi, at the end of Later Jin was in the Hanlin Academy and drafted the surrender memorial for the Outgoing Emperor; he knew the matter in detail.

units.zh: 記少帝初遷於黃龍府，後居於建州，凡十八年而卒。
units.en: It records that the Young Emperor was first sent to Huanglong, later lived at Jianzhou, and died after eighteen years.
units.literal: It records that the Young Emperor was first moved to Huanglong prefecture, later dwelt at Jianzhou, and after eighteen years in all died.

units.zh: 案：契丹丙午歲入汴，順數至甲子歲為十八年，實太祖乾德二年也。
units.en: Note: the Khitans entered Bian in the bingwu year; counting forward to jiazi gives eighteen years—the year Qiande 2 of Taizu.
units.literal: Note: in the Khitan year bingwu they entered Bian; counting forward to the year jiazi makes eighteen years—actually Taizu's Qiande 2.

units.zh: 《五代史補》：少主之嗣位也，契丹以不俟命而擅立；
units.en: Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties: when the Young Lord took the throne, the Khitans enthroned him without their leave;
units.literal: Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties: when the Young Lord succeeded the throne, the Khitans installed him without awaiting command;

units.zh: 又，景延廣辱其使。
units.en: and Jing Yanguang insulted their envoy.
units.literal: further, Jing Yanguang insulted their envoy.

units.zh: 契丹怒，舉國南侵。
units.en: The Khitans were enraged and invaded the south in force.
units.literal: The Khitans were enraged and the whole state invaded south.

units.zh: 以駙馬都尉杜重威等領駕下精兵甲禦之於中流渡橋。
units.en: Du Chongwei, Commander-in-Chief of the Imperial Son-in-Law, and others led the court's best armored troops to meet them at Zhongliu Crossing.
units.literal: Du Chongwei, imperial son-in-law commander, and others led the court's elite armored troops to resist them at Zhongliu Crossing Bridge.

units.zh: 既而契丹之眾已深入，而重威等奏報未到朝廷。
units.en: The Khitans had already penetrated deep inland before Chongwei's reports reached court.
units.literal: Soon the Khitan host had penetrated deep, yet Chongwei's memorial reports had not reached the court.

units.zh: 時桑維翰罷相，為開封府尹，謂僚佐曰：「事急矣，非大臣鉗口之時。」
units.en: Sang Weihan had left the chancellorship and was prefect of Kaifeng; he told his staff, "The crisis is acute; this is no time for ministers to hold their tongues."
units.literal: At that time Sang Weihan had left the chancellorship and was prefect of Kaifeng; he told his staff: "The matter is urgent; this is not the time for great ministers to clamp their mouths."

units.zh: 乃叩內閣求見，欲請車駕親征，以固將士之心。
units.en: He knocked at the inner gate seeking an audience, asking that the emperor lead the army in person to steady the troops.
units.literal: He then knocked at the inner gate seeking audience, wishing to request the imperial carriage go on campaign in person to steady the hearts of generals and soldiers.

units.zh: 而少主方在後苑調鷹，至暮竟不召。
units.en: But the Young Lord was in the rear park training hawks and never summoned him, even by evening.
units.literal: But the Young Lord was just in the rear park training hawks; until evening he was not summoned at all.

units.zh: 維翰退而嘆曰：「國家阽危如此，草澤逋客亦宜下問，況大臣求見而不召耶！
units.en: Weihan withdrew sighing, "The state stands on the brink of ruin; even a fugitive in the wilds ought to be consulted—how much less should a minister be refused when he begs an audience!
units.literal: Weihan withdrew and sighed: "The state is perched on peril like this; even a fugitive guest of the wilds and marshes ought to be questioned from above—how much more when a great minister seeks audience and is not summoned!

units.zh: 事亦可知矣。」
units.en: The outcome was already clear."
units.literal: The outcome can already be known."

units.zh: 未幾，杜重威之徒降於契丹，少主遂北遷。）〉
units.en: Soon Chongwei and his men surrendered to the Khitans, and the Young Lord was driven north.)〉
units.literal: Before long Du Chongwei's party surrendered to the Khitans, and the Young Lord then moved north.)〉

units.zh: 史臣曰：少帝以中人之才，嗣將墜之業，屬上天不祐，仍歲大饑，尚或絕強敵之歡盟，鄙輔臣之謀略。
units.en: The historian writes: the Young Emperor, a man of middling ability, inherited a dynasty in collapse. Heaven withheld its favor and famine stalked the land year after year; yet he still broke the alliance with a powerful enemy and scorned his ministers' counsel.
units.literal: The historiographer says: the Young Emperor with mediocre talent succeeded a falling enterprise; Heaven did not aid him, famine continued year after year; he still might sever friendly alliance with a strong foe and despise his assisting ministers' stratagems.

units.zh: 奢淫自縱，謂有泰山之安；
units.en: He gave himself to luxury and excess, believing his throne as secure as Mount Tai;
units.literal: Luxurious and licentious, he indulged himself, thinking he had Mount Tai's security;

units.zh: 委托非人，坐受平陽之辱。
units.en: he entrusted power to the wrong men and suffered the disgrace of Pingyang while doing nothing.
units.literal: he entrusted the wrong men and sat receiving the disgrace of Pingyang.

units.zh: 族行萬里，身老窮荒。
units.en: His clan was driven ten thousand li; he grew old in a barren land.
units.literal: His clan traveled ten thousand li; his person aged in desolate wilds.

units.zh: 自古亡國之醜者，無如帝之甚也。
units.en: Of all the disgraces of fallen rulers since antiquity, none surpass his.
units.literal: Among disgraces of perished states since antiquity, none match this Emperor's extremity.

units.zh: 千載之後，其如恥何，傷哉！
units.en: A thousand years from now, how will posterity bear such shame? Grievous indeed!
units.literal: A thousand years hence, how will men face such shame—grievous indeed!

candidatePacket.instructions: Review dates, event ownership, conversions, endpoint evidence, age reckoning, omitted life dates, and active-date hints. Read all Chinese units for omissions; English is not independent evidence. Do not re-extract names or mentions. For each item identify whose event is dated and justify each endpoint. Same mother does not imply same birth year. Later allusions are not personal activity. Research or record a blocker rather than invent precision. A report cannot approve with missing checks or unresolved research.

findings.problem: Claim-50 converts 「周顯德初」 to the exact year AD 954 even though the phrase means early in an era and supplies no exact year.
findings.action: Use a verified one-sided or interval representation that retains the source wording; independently review the revised extraction.

findings.problem: p045 is not a named individual: it merges generic references 「先人」「先君」「先帝」 and falsely presents them as one former Jin ruler.
findings.action: Run a separate source-only false-person audit/removal for p045 and its dependent claims, surfaces, mentions, and identity references; then re-audit the new extraction.

findings.problem: Wang Congke’s recall appears inside a December 946 memorial, but the passage does not date his earlier self-immolation; the existing record correctly flags this as unresolved.
findings.action: Preserve the research hold unless a source-qualified date for Wang Congke’s event is supplied. Do not assign AD 946 or an invented endpoint.
